content.title: Coachella 2026 YouTube Live Stream Schedule & Details
content.text: The 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival is once again set to livestream, and today, YouTube has revealed the full first-weekend schedule. Most of the weekend’s performances will air on the festival’s stage-by-stage streams, starting today (April 10) at 4 p.m. EST and running nonstop through the weekend. Scroll down to see when your favorite artists are playing and which channel to catch them on.Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, and Karol G are this year’s headliners. Joining them are Jack White, Geese, Young Thug, the xx, Turnstile, David Byrne, Dijon, FKA twigs, Addison Rae, Ethel Cain, Alex G, PinkPantheress, Oklou, and Iggy Pop, among others. If you were looking for Coachella’s on-site set times, head here.Follow along with all of Pitchfork’s coverage of Coachella 2026.
